scientific_choices.choice: Sections 3.3-3.5 use original-image crops, PARSeq-S and caption context; CLIP verification is an experimental extension, outside STRICT.
Reuse SHA-bound TRAIN125 threshold/pad0 PARSeq strings, source geometry and cached Florence-2-large-ft scene descriptions of the same original images.

Freeze output geometry and compare every candidate word against one common full image, baseline crop, doubled surrounding crop and target-masked surrounding crop; median RGB square canvas preserves the field of view.

Compare raw/written/three-prompt feature ensemble, word-first caption prompts, normalized text-feature residual against a neutral empty-word caption prompt and cyclically shuffled captions. Shorten only the common caption prefix to CLIP token budget.

Baseline-preserving ties, PARSeq confidence, equal midrank fusion, and a fixed 0.02 visual-gain gate with PARSeq/crop/surround agreement. No GT enters generation, scoring or selection; no thresholds fitted.
Test caption conditioning using existing Florence descriptions; this is not the paper's unresolved BLIP-2 selection, and captions may contain independent OCR guesses.
Standalone sequential CLIP model loading, float32 batch16 and explicit CPU or single-GPU execution; upstream PARSeq/caption caches have separate recorded runtimes.

Correctness calibration, model-version benefit, caption leakage/transfer, one-character error sensitivity and independent TEST performance. B16 upstream weight checksum still unverified; any actual local file is hashed and this limitation is recorded.
